title: aFRR, Activated Automatic Frequency Restoration Reserves (Discontinued, please read description)
description:
This dataset is no longer updated after October 2nd, 2024, because of the go-live of the PICASSO platform.

Activated aFRR, also called secondary reserve, is used to restore frequency to the normal band (49.9-50.1 Hz) after the primary regulation (FCR) has stabilised the frequency.

title: aFRR Border Available Transfer Capacity
description: Calculated available transfer capacity for given borders. The data here is based on ENTSO-E standard border definition direction - meaning East->West, North->South.

title: aFRR Energy Activation
description: The energy volume activated by the LFC.

title: aFRR LFC Activation Limits
description: Hard limits for how much energy the LFC is allowed to activate.

title: aFRR Picasso Corrections

title: aFRR - DK1 Skagerak (Discontinued, please read description)
description:
This dataset is no longer updated. For data after August 2020, please find data here [aFRR, Activated Automatic Frequency Restoration Reserves](https://www.energidataservice.dk/tso-electricity/AfrrActivatedAutomatic) or [aFRR, Automatic Frequency Restoration Reserves, Nordic capacity market](https://www.energidataservice.dk/tso-electricity/AfrrReservesNordic)

Automatic Frequency Restoration Reserves (aFRR), also called secondary reserve, is an automatic 15-minute power control. It shows amounts and prices in Western Denmark. The data is historic, and only includes aFRR through Skagerak (Norway).

title: aFRR, Automatic Frequency Restoration Reserves, Capacity Market
description: Energinet makes daily procurement of automatic frequency restoration reserves (aFRR) on an hourly capacity market. This site provides market-related information for the balancing capacity market. Here, you can find details on requested demand, procured volumes, and reserve prices across different directions and price areas per hour.

title: Countertrade Procured in Intraday (Discontinued – see description)
description:
The dataset has been discontinued. For data published after 2025-10-14 see [Countertrade Procured in Intraday](https://www.energidataservice.dk/tso-electricity/CountertradeIntraday_v2).

The volumes published below are the new volumes. The net volumes are requested to be traded in DK1 and may differ from countertrade data that is published as Change in Cross-Border Exchange [13.1.B] on [ENTSO-E Transparency Platform](https://transparency.entsoe.eu/congestion-management/r2/countertrading/show).

title: Countertrade Procured in Intraday
description:
This dataset provides countertrade data in 15-minute resolution, and replaced the hourly dataset [Countertrade Procured in Intraday (Discontinued)](https://www.energidataservice.dk/tso-electricity/CountertradeIntraday) on 15 October, 2025.

---

The volumes published below are the net volumes requested to be traded in DK1 and may differ from countertrade data published as Change in Cross-Border Exchange [13.1.B] on ENTSO-E Transparency Platform ([Transparency Platform](https://newtransparency.entsoe.eu/transmission/countertrading?appState=%7B%22sa%22%3A%5B%22BZN%7C10YDK-1--------W%22%5D%2C%22st%22%3A%22BZN%22%2C%22mm%22%3Atrue%2C%22ma%22%3Afalse%2C%22sp%22%3A%22FULL%22%2C%22dt%22%3A%22TABLE%22%2C%22df%22%3A%5B%222025-09-09%22%2C%222025-09-09%22%5D%2C%22tz%22%3A%22CET%22%7D)), as the data on ENTSO-E Transparency Platform reflects the actual traded volumes on the border.

The volumes to be traded are also published on NUCS and can be found here: [NUCS - Countertrade to be procured in intraday](https://www.nucs.net/transmission-domain/counterTrade/show?name=&defaultValue=false&viewType=TABLE&areaType=BZN&atch=false&areaSelectType=USER_SELECTED&biddingZone.values=CTY%7C10Y1001A1001A65H!BZN%7C10YDK-1--------W&biddingZone.values=CTY%7C10Y1001A1001A65H!BZN%7C10YDK-2--------M&sender.values=10X1001A1001A248&sender.values=10X1001A1001A38Y).
According to Energinet’s methodology for procurement of countertrading energy, the volumes published on NUCS/EDS, prior to the trading is initiated, reflect the energy Energinet intends to trade in the intraday market. Consequently, the publication does not guarantee that the energy is, in effect, traded.

title: Day-Ahead Prices
description:
Day-Ahead Prices for Denmark and Neighboring Countries.

This dataset provides day-ahead electricity prices for Denmark (DK1 and DK2) and neighboring countries in the Nord Pool market, including Norway, Sweden, Finland, and Germany. In the day-ahead market, participants buy and sell electricity for delivery the following day within their respective bidding zones.

title: Entry/Exit Gas Flow and Quality
description:
The dataset consists of the hourly flow and gas quality values for all entry/exit points in the Danish gas transmission system.

Gas quality naturally varies depending on the origin of the gas. Here is given the hourly unvalidated data for the entry/exit and central points: Nybro (Danish North Sea), Dragør Border (Sweden), Ellund (Germany), Bevtoft (biomethane plant), Ll. Torup (Storage), Stenlille (Storage), Faxe (Poland), and North Sea (Norway)). Gas delivered to Danish consumers may originate from more than one supply source.

Data at Nybro with a negative sign indicates that the gas is used for consumption at the M/R station. This consumption exceeds the production flow from the North Sea.

title: FCR, Frequency Containment Reserves, DK1
description:
Amount and prices of FCR regulation in bidding zone (Price area) DK1.

Frequency Containment Reserve, FCR, also called primary reserve, must ensure that the balance between generation and demand is restored, stabilising the frequency at close to, but deviating from 50 Hz.

title: FCR N and D, Frequency Containment Reserves, DK2
description:
Frequency Containment Reserve - Normal operation/-Disturbance, FCR N and D, also called primary reserve, is there to stabilize the frequency in the electricity grid in DK2 and in the rest of the Nordic synchronous area, in the event of a frequency dip/jump.

Energinet procures FCR-N, FCR-D up and FCR-D down capacity reserve in collaboration with Svenska Kraftnät in daily auctions where part of the required volume is procured two days before the day of operation, D-1 early (former D-2) and the remaining part is procured the day before the day of operation, D-1 late (former D-1).

title: Gas Capacity Usage
description:
**Update:**
Currently, the dataset Gas Capacity Usage is under review. The affected columns are **Available Interruptible Capacity**, **Interruptible Capacity**, and **Booked Interruptible**. Please note that Energinet does not offer Interruptible Capacity products, but only Interruptible Overnomination.

Gas Capacity Usage shows the capacity, available and booked capacity at each entry/exit point in the Danish gas market.

The view is updated frequently during the gas day.

For the information on interruptible terms please refer to the interruptible column description.

The data are validated but the data cannot be used for billing purposes. Prices will remain unvalidated until the invoicing of balancing gas. Non-valid balancing gas prices should provide Shippers with an indication on what to expect.

title: Commercial Gas Amounts

title: Gas Daily System Commercial Balance

description:
Herfindahl - Hirschman Index (HHI) is a method used to determine the market competitiveness.

Data is updated on the 8th the following month.

title: Imbalance Price
description: This dataset shows all relevant information regarding the imbalance price design. The data is in 15-minute resolution and shows satisfied demand and the imbalance price and contains all the components relevant to the imbalance price, including the aFRR volumes, aFRR volume-weighted average price, and the mFRR marginal price.

title: Inertia, Nordic Synchronous Area
description: The inertia reflects the rotating mass of the active production units. The unit is GWs.

title: mFRR, manual Frequency Restoration Reserves, Capacity Market
description: Energinet makes daily procurement of manuel frequency restoration reserves (mFRR), on an hourly capacity market. This site provides market-related information for the balancing capacity market, which runs every morning. Here, you can find details on requested demand, procured volumes, and reserve prices across different directions and price areas per hour.

title: mFRR, manual Frequency Restoration Reserves, Capacity Market, Extra Auctions
description: Energinet makes procurement of manuel frequency restoration reserves (mFRR) in an afternoon auction on an hourly capacity market – only if additional reserves are needed. This site provides market-related information for the balancing capacity market. Here, you can find details on requested demand, procured volumes, and reserve prices across different directions and price areas per hour.

title: mFRR Energy Activation Market
description:
The dataset consolidates prices and volumes from the mFRR Energy Activation Market and provides a comprehensive overview of the different activation types within the market.
The mFRR Energy Activation Market (EAM) dataset is dynamic; therefore, some data may be updated prior to and/or during the MTU as scheduled activations and direct activations occur.
The data provide an indication of the expected dominating direction for the MTU. However, the final calculation of satisfied demand determines the actual dominating direction, which is reflected in the [imbalance price](https://energidataservice.dk/tso-electricity/ImbalancePrice) data (from March 4th, 2026).

title: Realtime Market (Discontinued, please read description)
description:
This dataset is no longer updated. Use instead [Regulating and Balance power, overall data](https://www.energidataservice.dk/tso-electricity/RegulatingBalancePowerdata)

Maintaining balance between consumption and production in the electricity system and fulfilling contracts with e.g. Sweden or Norway may require an up or down regulation of production and consumption in the Danish electricity system (east or west). For this purpose a so-called regulating power market is established as a common market for the Nordic countries.

In connection with the go-live of the new imbalance price design, the dataset [Imbalance Price](https://www.energidataservice.dk/tso-electricity/ImbalancePrice) was introduced, replacing [Regulating and Balance Power, Overall Data](https://www.energidataservice.dk/tso-electricity/RegulatingBalancePowerdata).
